resources.string: CPU is the default. Compare CPU, Vulkan or Adreno OpenCL results in Benchmarks on your phone.

Requests GPU offload on a compatible driver. Some operations can remain on CPU. Memory use and heat can increase; speed depends on the model and phone. Errors stay visible; CPU requires an explicit switch.
Optional GPU runtimes are available in the ARM64 build. Choose CPU on this device.

Applies to the next GGUF translator opened by typed text, captions, conversation or camera. Restart an active caption session to apply. Marian, platform language packs, speech recognition and voices use their own engines.
